name: VOT2016
description: An evaluation suite and challenge that measures accuracy and robustness of single-object visual trackers on the VOT2016 sequences.
evaluation_method: Expected Average Overlap (EAO) and robustness (failure rate)
notes: Non-LLM visual tracking benchmark; evaluation emphasizes EAO and failure rate. Dataset is relatively small and challenge-style evaluation can encourage overfitting to benchmark sequences.
